details.judge_reason: Headline text is sharply rendered in bold white sans-serif font with high contrast against dark background.

product.reason: The advertised watch is a completely different analog dress watch, lacking G-Shock's digital display, branding, buttons, and bracelet.

observations.presence: A wristwatch is shown in the ad, but it is an analog dress watch, not the reference G-Shock MT-G digital watch.
observations.shape: Reference has a bulky, angular digital watch case with rotated bezel buttons; ad shows a thin, round, minimalist analog case.
observations.colour: Reference is silver/titanium with gray resin bezel; ad watch is gold-toned metal with a brown leather strap, no resin bezel.
observations.logo: Reference clearly shows 'G-SHOCK' and 'CASIO' branding; ad watch has no visible brand text, only a tiny unreadable emblem.
observations.prominent_text: Reference has digital display with day/date, 'WAVE CEPTOR/TOUGH SOLAR', 'MT-G', 'WATER 200M RESIST'; ad watch has a blank analog dial with no text at all.
observations.counts: reference: 1 digital display with multiple sub-indicators (battery, receiving indicator, day/date) / ad: 1 plain analog dial with hour markers only, no sub-dials
observations.parts: Reference has metal bracelet band with multiple buttons (Adjust, Mode, Receive, Time Memo); ad watch has a leather strap and a single crown, no buttons.

season_fit.reason: Dark evening sky, icy wet rocks, and moody blue tones are consistent with Reykjavik's winter climate.

market_fit.reason: Coastal rocky scene with distant harbor lights plausibly fits Reykjavik; no wrong-country elements present.

no_cliche.reason: No forced landmarks, flags, or token souvenirs; natural coastal rock and lighting feel authentic, not stereotyped.
